about: Phrases a student may put in quotation marks that are not from Away: Common Module rubric wording that students commonly quote. A quotation matching one of these, or the essay question's own wording, is status 'other-source': not flagged and not a knowledge error. This list is NOT part of the marking prompt, so editing it does not change promptVersion; rerun the quote parity check after any edit. Wording should be checked against the current NESA syllabus.
phrases: human qualities and emotions associated with, or arising from, these experiences
anomalies, paradoxes and inconsistencies in human behaviour and motivation
inviting the responder to see the world differently
to challenge assumptions, ignite new ideas or reflect personally
